items.text: Amadodana kaLevi ayengoGerishoni loKohathi loMerari.
Amadodana kaKohathi ayengoAmramu loIzihari loHebroni loUziyeli.
Abantwana bakaAmramu babengoAroni loMose loMiriyamu. Amadodana kaAroni ayengoNadabi loAbihu loEleyazare loIthamari.
UEleyazare wazala uFiniyasi; uFiniyasi wazala uAbishuwa;
uAbishuwa wazala uBuki; uBuki wazala uUzi;
uUzi wazala uZerahiya; uZerahiya wazala uMerayothi;
uMerayothi wazala uAmariya; uAmariya wazala uAhitubi;
uAhitubi wazala uZadoki; uZadoki wazala uAhimazi;
uAhimazi wazala uAzariya; uAzariya wazala uJohanani;
uJohanani wazala uAzariya owaba ngumpristi ethempelini uSolomoni alakha eJerusalema.
UAzariya wazala uAmariya; uAmariya wazala uAhitubi;
uAhitubi wazala uZadoki; uZadoki wazala uShaluma;
uShaluma wazala uHilikiya; uHilikiya wazala uAzariya;
uAzariya wazala uSeraya; uSeraya wazala uJehozadaki.
UJehozadaki wathunjwa lapho iNkosi ithumba uJuda leJerusalema ngesandla sikaNebukadineza.
Amadodana kaLevi ayengoGerishoni loKohathi loMerari.
Amabizo amadodana kaGerishoni ayengoLibini loShimeyi.
Amadodana kaKohathi ayengoAmramu loIzihari loHebroni loUziyeli.
Amadodana kaMerari ayengoMahli loMushi. Nantu usendo lwamaLevi ngezindlu zawo;
kwabakoGerishoni kwakunguLibini indodana yakhe, loJahathi indodana kaLibini, loZima indodana kaJahathi,
loJowa indodana kaZima, loIdo indodana kaJowa, loZera indodana kaIdo, loJeyatherayi indodana kaZera.
Inzalo kaKohathi yayingoAminadaba, lomntanakhe uKora, lomntanakhe uAsiri,
lomntanakhe uElkana, lomntanakhe uEbiyasafi, lomntanakhe uAsiri,
lomntanakhe uTahathi, lomntanakhe uUriyeli, lomntanakhe uUziya, lomntanakhe uShawuli.
Amadodana kaElkana ayengoAmasayi loAhimothi,
loElkana indodana kaAhimothi, loZofayi indodana kaElkana, loNahathi indodana kaZofayi,
loEliyabi indodana kaNahathi, loJerohamu indodana kaEliyabi, loElkana indodana kaJerohamu.
Amadodana kaSamuweli ayengoJoweli izibulo, loAbija eyesibili.
Inzalo kaMerari yayingoMahli, lomntanakhe uLibini, lomntanakhe uShimeyi, lomntanakhe uUza,
lomntanakhe uShimeya, lomntanakhe uHagiya, lomntanakhe uAsaya.
Nampa abantu uDavida abakhethayo ukuba baphathe ukuhlabela endlini yeNkosi umtshokotsho
usubekiwe khona.
Bakhonza ngokuhlabela phambi
lethente lokuhlangana, uSolomoni waze wakha ithempeli eJerusalema; benza inkonzo yabo ngokuzophisana.
Nampa abantu abakhonzayo lamadodana abo; kumadodana amaKohathi kwakunguHemani umhlabeleli indodana kaJoweli kaSamuweli
kaElkana kaJerohamu kaEliyeli kaTowa
kaZufi kaElkana kaMahathi kaAmasayi
kaElkana kaJoweli kaAzariya kaZefaniya
kaTahathi kaAsiri kaAbiyasafi kaKora
kaIzihari kaKohathi kaLevi kaIsrayeli.
UAsafi umfowabo kaHemani wema ngakwesokunene sakhe, uAsafi indodana kaBerekiya kaShimeya
kaMikayeli kaBahaseya kaMalikiya
kaEthini kaZera kaAdaya
kaEthani kaZima kaShimeyi
kaJahathi kaGerishoni kaLevi.
Ngakwesokhohlo sabo kwakukhona umfowabo owenzalo kaMerari, uEthani indodana kaKishi kaAbidi kaMaluki
kaHashabiya kaAmaziya kaHilikiya
kaAmizi kaBani kaShemeri
kaMahli kaMushi kaMerari kaLevi.
Izihlobo zabo amaLevi bamiswa ukwenza yonke inkonzo yeTabernakeli lendlu kaNkulunkulu.

Kodwa kwakunguAroni lamadodana akhe abanikela iminikelo phezu kwealtare lomnikelo wokutshiswa laphezu kwealtare lempepha, ukwenza yonke inkonzo endaweni engcwele kakhulu lokwenzela uIsrayeli indlela yokubuyisana, njengakho konke uMose inceku kaNkulunkulu akutshoyo.
Nansi inzalo kaAroni; oEleyazare, lomntanakhe uFiniyasi, lomntanakhe uAbishuwa,
lomntanakhe uBuki, lomntanakhe uUzi, lomntanakhe uZerahiya,
lomntanakhe uMerayothi, lomntanakhe uAmariya, lomntanakhe uAhitubi,
lomntanakhe uZadoki, lomntanakhe uAhimazi.
Nansi imizi yamaLevi endaweni zawo ezanikwa amadodana kaAroni, osendweni lwamaKohathi, ngoba yiwo adliwa yinkatho.
Bawanika iHebroni elizweni lakoJuda lamadlelo alizingelezeleyo;
kodwa amasimu omuzi lemizana yawo bakunika uKalebi indodana kaJefune.
Banika amadodana kaAroni imizi le, iHebroni umuzi wokuphephela, leLibina lamadlelo alo, leJathiri, leEshitemowa lamadlelo alo,
leHileni lamadlelo alo, leDebiri lamadlelo alo,
leAshani lamadlelo alo, leBeti‐Shemeshi lamadlelo alo;
esizweni sakoBenjamini anikwa iGeba lamadlelo alo, leAlemethi lamadlelo alo, leAnathothi lamadlelo alo; kwakuyimizi elitshumi lantathu.
Banika amaKohathi aseleyo imizi elitshumi ngenkatho, beyithatha engxenyeni yesizwe sakoManase.
Banika amaGerishoni ngosendo lwawo imizi elitshumi lantathu, beyithatha esizweni sakoIsakari lesakoAsheri lesakoNafitali lesakoManase eBashani.
Banika amaMerari ngosendo lwawo imizi elitshumi lambili ngenkatho, beyithatha esizweni sakoRubeni lesakoGadi lesakoZebuluni.
Abantu bakoIsrayeli bawanika amaLevi limizi kanye lamadlelo ayo.
Leyomizi esiqanjiwe evela esizweni sakoJuda lesakoSimeyoni lesakoBenjamini layo babanika ngenkatho.
Ezinye insendo zamadodana kaKohathi zanikwa imizi esizweni sakoEfrayimi.
Zanikwa imizi le, iShekema umuzi wokuphephela lamadlelo alo ezintabeni zakoEfrayimi, leGezeri lamadlelo alo,
leJokimeyamu lamadlelo alo, leBeti‐Horoni lamadlelo alo,
leAjaloni lamadlelo alo, leGathi‐Rimoni lamadlelo alo;
engxenyeni yesizwe sakoManase kwanikwa insendo eziseleyo zamaKohathi iAneri lamadlelo alo, leBileyamu lamadlelo alo.
AmaGerishoni anikwa engxenyeni yesizwe sakoManase iGolani laseBashani lamadlelo alo, leAshitarothi lamadlelo alo;
anikwa esizweni sakoIsakari iKedeshi lamadlelo alo, leDaberathi lamadlelo alo,
leRamothi lamadlelo alo, leAnema lamadlelo alo;
anikwa esizweni sakoAsheri iMashali lamadlelo alo, leAbidoni lamadlelo alo,
leHukoki lamadlelo alo, leRehobi lamadlelo alo;
anikwa esizweni sakoNafitali iKedeshi eliseGalili lamadlelo alo, leHamoni lamadlelo alo, leKiriyathayimi lamadlelo alo.
AmaMerari aseleyo anikwa esizweni sakoZebuluni iRimono lamadlelo alo, leTabori lamadlelo alo;
ngasempumalanga kweJordani, maqondana leJeriko, esizweni sakoRubeni anikwa iBezeri yasenkangala lamadlelo alo, leJahiza lamadlelo alo,
leKedemothi lamadlelo alo, leMefahathi lamadlelo alo;
esizweni sakoGadi anikwa iRamothi eGileyadi lamadlelo alo, leMahanayimi lamadlelo alo,
leHeshiboni lamadlelo alo, leJazeri lamadlelo alo.
